en: A black‑and‑white aerial or elevated panoramic photograph of a dense historic town with rows of stepped‑gabled houses in the foreground and many church spires and traditional brick buildings stretching into the distance. The lower margin contains printed captions in French and English identifying the view as Bruges and describing it as a bird's‑eye view of the town, along with a small number "177" on the left and a printer's mark on the right.
